releaseIntent: Finish one bounded open-source v1.2 release by reducing the product to its portable collaboration kernel, host-admission standard, representative help-and-interference evaluation and two thin reference projections. Release is a maintained baseline for later field learning, not an assertion of universal or final human-AI collaboration effectiveness.

completedIncrement.observedProblem: The sound goal-first collaboration proposition accumulated host-specific proof machinery, duplicated prose authority and generation-specific validators. Two months of honest Codex-led trial and correction exposed repair-by-addition, proof-proxy, context and topology burden, stale evidence replay and cleanup failure modes. A clean historical verifier now fails by replaying superseded O1 evidence, demonstrating that the proof path can obstruct the current product. The first GT-02 dirty-repository run then exposed hidden Python cache residue, and the same cleanup failure repeated after one minimal instruction repair; this proves that an observed host failure must narrow host qualification rather than trigger another prompt layer or be misclassified as Harness release failure. Post-reshape adversarial review then reproduced repository-self-authorized release completion, out-of-root absence probes, expanded install or execution surfaces and partial projection-identity replay.
completedIncrement.hypothesis: A small K1-K5 portable kernel, H1-H10 host-admission standard, L1-L7 learned-failure standard, one data-driven verifier, representative help-and-interference Golden Tasks and thin Codex and Claude projections can preserve the useful lessons, distinguish Harness conformance from host behavior qualification, and cut default complexity enough to produce a finite, reproducible v1.2 release.
falsifiers: the reshape creates a new runtime, registry, router, ledger, context predictor or generic control plane
historical O1-O5 validators or evidence remain on the default verification path
the verifier duplicates product prose or derives success from implementation, tests, receipts, commits or report shape

the Codex or Claude projection requires a long mandatory profile, fixed host version, universal context threshold, user-operated capability or topology route, or default activation of a separately governed user-level Skill
a representative task failure is hidden, promoted into a pass, erased by evaluator cleanup, or left without an exact host claim limit and residue disposition
a material shortfall invariant or two-month counterexample disappears rather than becoming a compact rule, test or explicit claim limit
tracked active code, product-test and primary-instruction complexity does not materially fall from the pre-reshape baseline
release or field-effect is claimed before its exact evidence and named-human authority
repository data grants human authority, an absence locator escapes the repository, or a Skill-only package admits an undeclared install, runtime or execution surface
completedIncrement.finiteStopCondition: The three authority files validate; the old proof generations leave the active tree; one generic verifier and both thin host projections map the same K, H, L, R and Q contract; the finite representative sample records help, interference, pass and failure without stale projection replay; every failure narrows the exact host claim; all eight repository criteria have direct bounded evidence; evaluator-owned residue is absent; and the repository is a clean local release candidate. Exact-candidate hosted verification, named-human authority, exact tagged public release, live release verification and goal-carrier cleanup remain ordered external gates rather than self-reported increment results.

deliverables: one generic verifier and instant host-admission command
two thin progressively disclosed host projections
project-audit custody and shared-research revision reference
small public documentation and release-candidate evidence

closeoutSequence.stopCondition: The accountable project human accepts the static-admission-only R2 evidence, the bounded GT-01 and GT-07 passes, and the retained GT-02 failure without expanding any claim.

All repository criteria have direct bounded evidence; the canonical verifier, product tests, both host checks, complexity, privacy and residue checks pass locally; the release path has been exercised on a prior exact pushed revision; and the final exact-HEAD hosted, human, publication and postcondition gates remain external.

workItems.stopCondition: A clean checkout reproduces all required deterministic checks, the finite representative sample and all pass/failure decisions are independently reviewable, failed host behaviors are excluded from the release claim, complexity targets pass, evaluator-owned residue is absent and only the ordered external release procedure remains.

orderedGates.condition: A single clean local candidate contains the aligned constitution, program, acceptance, goal prompt, evidence and derived documentation; all eight repository criteria are directly evidenced; canonical, host, product, complexity, privacy and residue checks pass; and push authority is already granted.

After the candidate is pushed, the active goal carrier must directly verify the unchanged clean HEAD on GitHub Actions for Linux, Windows and macOS plus ordinary Codex Cloud; limitations remain explicit and no repository write or caller-supplied receipt may chase its own evidence.

Only after exact hosted verification, present the unchanged SHA, claim ceiling, retained GT-02 failure and continuing evidence lanes to a named accountable human; the task-bound human decision must explicitly authorize publication and release while preserving a real veto and must not be written into the candidate.

Create the lightweight v1.2 tag and public release only after the goal carrier has directly verified the hosted gate and the later named-human decision for the unchanged candidate; do not mutate the authorized candidate, move the tag or add attached assets.

The active goal carrier directly verifies the live GitHub release, remote and local tag, exact tracked release notes and zero-attached-asset policy against the authorized candidate; it then removes task-created temporary resources, confirms repository and evaluator residue are absent, replays local validation and only then closes the finite goal.

releaseProcedure.rule: Execute gates strictly in listed dependency order. A gate may not begin until its predecessor is verified; failure returns to the smallest affected earlier gate, and no plan, test, push, hosted pass or authorization is promoted into a later effect.

goalModePrompt.objective: 在 product/constitution.json、product/program.json、product/acceptance.json 构成的唯一产品权威下，以已确认的 R2、GT-01、GT-07 判断和保留失败的 GT-02 为证据边界，将 Agent Autonomy Harness v1.2 收敛为 K1-K5 可移植协作内核、H1-H10 宿主准入标准、L1-L7 试错经验标准、Codex/Claude 薄投影及可复现的帮助与干扰评估；持续对齐并校准计划、严格工序、R1-R4/Q1-Q4 验收、目标提示词、证据、资源和载体状态，最小纠偏并控制过程损失。独立治理的用户级自研 Skill 不属于发行依赖：没有已复现残余缺口时保持未投影，发生投影时只要求共享 K/H/L 语义与生命周期边界，允许宿主要求的名称、清单和元数据差异。按且仅按以下顺序推进：形成单一干净仓库候选；推送后由当前目标任务直接复验同一精确 SHA 的 GitHub Linux/Windows/macOS 与普通 Codex Cloud，不接受仓库自报或调用方票据；再暂停请求具名人类对该 SHA、主张上限、公开与发布作最终决定且不写回候选；授权后创建绑定该 SHA 的轻量 v1.2 tag 和公开 release；最后由当前目标任务直接复验 GitHub 公开 release、远端与本地 tag、精确发布说明和零附加资产策略，清理任务资源并重放本地验证。不得把报告、计划、代码、测试、提交、推送、转场、局部通过、自填证据、托管绿灯或授权本身称为收官；仓库 verifier 只判契约一致性，不判仓库外门；真实场域、跨宿主和长期效果保持为发布后持续证据通道。任何前置门失败都退回最小受影响步骤；只有遇到必须由人类承担的判断、账户、外部信任、发布或不可逆边界才暂停并提出最小接管步骤，验证完成后继续，直至有限 v1.2 真实收官。
goalModePrompt.hostLifecycleNote: The accountable user explicitly resumed this exact no-budget objective in the current host task on 2026-08-20 and authorized all in-scope global consistency updates and pushes. The repository program is ready only for the ordered external gates; the host goal remains active until the current goal carrier directly verifies exact hosted execution, named-human authorization, exact tagged public release, public claims and cleanup. The repository verifier never decides those facts, and this lifecycle state proves no release or field outcome.

complexityBudget.rule: Every retained mechanism must pay rent in observed help, risk reduction or recovery value after code, prompt, evidence, topology, cognition and lifecycle cost. A failed target blocks Q3 rather than inviting a larger verifier.

processLossControl.carrierRule: Use current source-bound host signals when reliable; if capacity is unavailable, record unknown and transition conservatively. No universal turn count, context size, token percentage or summary ratio is product authority.
processLossControl.correctionRule: A repeated correction or failed same-purpose mechanism pauses further addition until the premise, interface and deletion option are reconsidered.
processLossControl.continuingCalibration: Post-release failures may update Golden Tasks, narrow a claim, simplify or retire a projection, or open one new bounded increment; release status does not freeze learning.
